description.value: Donair Dude is a Mediterranean-style fast food chain that opened its first location on Davie Street during the 2010 Vancouver Winter Olympics and has since grown into a multi-location franchise. The restaurant serves freshly prepared donairs, pita wraps, and platters made with premium BC-sourced meats slowly roasted in-house, alongside a dedicated vegan menu featuring falafel. The Davie Street location sits in Vancouver's walkable West End and offers both indoor and outdoor seating.
